# Muhammad Khan

> Engineering lead and full-stack developer based in Lahore, Pakistan. Builds software end to end: databases, APIs, web front ends, and mobile apps with React Native and Expo.

## About

- Currently leading engineering at TechHive, across EdTech, HealthTech and ERP projects.
- Previously Senior Full Stack Developer and team lead for Floor Insights at WiMetrix, carrying real-time IoT data from devices to web and Android apps.
- Works mainly with TypeScript/JavaScript, React, React Native, Expo, Node.js, Ruby on Rails and Python.
- BS in Software Engineering, Virtual University of Pakistan.
